Work with the generation workflows your account has submitted. A workflow is one submitted generation job. `civitai generate` prints a workflow id; `list` and `get` are how you find one afterwards — which is what makes `--no-wait`, a --timeout expiry and a Ctrl-C recoverable rather than a dead end. `list` and `get` are reads and SPEND NOTHING. 🔴 `cancel` stops a job, and you stay billed for what it had already delivered — the server re-prices the rest.
